question.question: What did Calvin do recently at his Japanese house?

evidence_items.text:
- In the week before 2023-05-16 (~2023-05-08/14), his home flooded — the "incident" he called "tough"/"rough" — but he managed to save his music gear and his favorite microphone [S6T3].
- He's staying positive and looking forward to getting everything fixed up [S6T3].
- Waiting on insurance to kick in before he can start repairs — hoping it won't take too long [S6T5].
- While telling Dave about the flood, shared a photo of his home music studio (see ## Music) [S6T5].
- Dave expressed sympathy, said the gear and mic were "the important things," and offered to help [S6T4].

evidence_items.speaker: Calvin
evidence_items.text:
- Announced a "big life change" and shared a photo of his "new mansion" (a building with a sign on the front) [S1T3].
- As of 2023-07-07, revealed the home is a Japanese mansion with an "epic cityscape" — "It's like a dream come true!"; the city lights through the windows are "so awe-inspiring" — "Luxury and beauty on a whole new level." The backyard overlooks a canal with a boat docked in it (photo taken at sunset); shared a photo of the front of the mansion (a large house with a lot of windows and lights) [S10T6][S10T8].

- On 2023-06-21, told Dave about the car accident and repair process (details in ## Car accident (2023-06-16)); Dave expressed sympathy that no one was hurt, asked about issues with the insurance process and how long it took, and asked about the mechanic in the garage photo [S9T2][S9T4][S9T6][S9T8].
- The 2023-06-21 conversation continued: Calvin answered Dave's skiing question — never tried it, but it looks like "a lot of fun" and he might try it once (details in ## Mountains and hiking) [S9T17]. Dave then announced that he recently joined a rock band and has been practicing guitar, sharing a photo of the band; Calvin said it's awesome and will bring him a lot of emotions, and Dave said good company and great music lift the mood and bring positive emotions (details in the Rock band section of /memories/dave.md). The conversation closed with Dave saying he had to go and "I'll see you soon!", and Calvin thanking Dave and saying "let's keep in touch, take care!" [S9T18][S9T19][S9T20][S9T21].
- On 2023-07-07, caught up with Dave: Dave asked how the car was doing after the crash, and Calvin said it's all good now — fixed and going strong — sharing a photo of the red sports car parked on the side of the road (details in ## Car accident (2023-06-16)). Dave said he's been hanging out with friends at parks; Calvin shared photos of his mansion's backyard (a boat docked in a canal at sunset) and the mansion front, and Dave marveled at the views from the Japanese mansion (details in ## New home (2023-03-23)) [S10T1][S10T2][S10T3][S10T5][S10T6][S10T7][S10T8].
- The 2023-07-07 conversation continued: Calvin is looking forward to trying the Japanese food and checking out the culture; when Dave said he has never been to Japan but is "so keen to go one day" and is "hooked on" Japanese music, Calvin said Japan "definitely has it all" — vibes, food, tech, and an amazing culture, "like stepping into another world" — and told him he's working on music collaborations with Japanese artists; Dave can't wait for the tunes, and Calvin promised to share clips and "can't wait to show you" the results. The conversation closed with Calvin thanking Dave, "Appreciate all the help", and saying "Great catching up, gotta get back to work now. Take care!" (Dave's Japan travel interest is in /memories/dave.md > ## Japan) [S10T9][S10T10][S10T11][S10T12][S10T13][S10T14][S10T15][S10T16]. Dave's final sign-off: "Hey Cal, take care and don't overwork yourself! Talk to you soon. Stay safe!" [S10T17].
- On 2023-08-03, reconnected with Dave ("long time no see!"): told him the recent Ferrari service was so stressful and that he's attached to the car, and asked what kind of hobbies give Dave a feeling of being restored; Dave said fixing cars is like therapy for him and shared his fond memories of working on cars with his dad as a kid (details in /memories/dave.md > ## Hobbies and sense of purpose) [S12T1][S12T2][S12T3].
- The 2023-08-03 conversation continued: Dave shared a childhood photo of himself and his dad (a man and a child posing), which Calvin found cool ("Reminiscing is always fun!"); Calvin then shared a photo of his red Ferrari on a lift in a garage, saying his car is the best — "Sure, it's just material, but it reminds me of my hard work and dedication"; Dave said the car looks great, "I can tell why you're proud," and that it's "like a reminder of what you can achieve" (details of the car in ## New luxury car (Ferrari, 2023-03-26)) [S12T4][S12T5][S12T6][S12T7][S12T8].
- On 2023-07-21, caught up with Dave ("been ages since we spoke!"): Dave told him he'd just returned from a road trip with friends (details in /memories/dave.md) and asked what Calvin had been up to; Calvin told him about the recording-studio project in the Japanese mansion, shared a progress photo, said he's been experimenting with electronic elements, and discussed the challenge of balancing his signature sound with new styles (details in ## Recording studio (2023-07-21)) [S11T1][S11T4][S11T6][S11T8].
- The 2023-07-21 conversation closed with Calvin thanking Dave — his support "means a lot to me" — and saying he's gonna keep pushing himself and striving for his goals; Dave replied "You got this! ... I'm your biggest fan. Let's chat soon!", and Calvin signed off "Appreciate your support. Let's catch up soon and chat. Take care!" (Dave's side of the exchange in /memories/dave.md > ## Relationships) [S11T12][S11T13][S11T14].
- The 2023-08-03 conversation continued: Dave asked what Calvin's biggest goal is (music-wise or otherwise); Calvin named his plan for now (expand his brand worldwide and grow his fanbase — details in ## Music) and shared a photo of performing with his band "the boys" the night before (2023-08-02), saying they are "great at the music". The conversation closed with mutual encouragement — Calvin: Dave's support and encouragement "mean a lot to me", he's "determined to make my dreams come true" and will "keep going for my dreams"; Dave: "Keep it up and keep making a difference!", "Keep at it and never forget your dreams!", "stay focused and keep going... You've got this!" [S12T10][S12T11][S12T12][S12T13][S12T14][S12T15][S12T16]. Calvin thanked Dave and signed off: "Thanks, Dave! I'll stay focused and keep going. Appreciate your belief!" [S12T17].

- On 2023-05-03, said embracing nature has been really calming for him, and that he's been loving getting to know Japanese culture [S5T10].
- As of 2023-06-21, has a small town in Japan on his to-do list to visit after his tour with Frank Ocean ends — he has never been there. Shared a photo of a small-town view with a mountain in the background, saying the view of the mountains is "unbelievably stunning"; can't wait to see it in person [S9T11][S9T13][S9T14][S9T15].
- As of 2023-07-07, still living in Japan — his home is a Japanese mansion with an epic cityscape (see ## New home (2023-03-23)) [S10T6].
- As of 2023-07-07, looking forward to trying the Japanese food and checking out the culture — "Japan is indeed amazing" [S10T10].
- As of 2023-07-07, is working on music collaborations with Japanese artists (a continuation of his plan to collaborate with musicians in the area, see above) — "really excited to hear how it turns out"; promised Dave he'll share some clips when everything's ready; says collaborating with various artists is "always exciting, it's a chance to create something unique" [S10T12][S10T14].

- On 2023-06-21, Calvin shared a photo of a person on skis on a snowy mountain ("Look at that snowy peak"); Dave asked whether Calvin has ever tried skiing before, and Calvin answered that he hasn't tried it, but it looks like "a lot of fun" and he might give it a try once — see /memories/calvin.md > ## Mountains and hiking [S9T15][S9T16][S9T17].
- The 2023-06-21 conversation continued: Dave announced that he recently joined a rock band and has been practicing guitar, sharing a photo of the band (a group of men playing instruments in a room — "it's us, the guys!"); Calvin said playing guitar in a rock band is awesome and will bring him a lot of emotions; Dave said good company and great music lift the mood and bring a lot of positive emotions (details in ## Rock band). The conversation closed with Dave saying he had to go, "I'll see you soon!", and Calvin thanking Dave and saying "let's keep in touch, take care!" [S9T17][S9T18][S9T19][S9T20][S9T21].
- On 2023-07-07, caught up with Calvin: asked how the car was doing after the crash, and Calvin said it's all good now — fixed and going strong (see the Car accident section of /memories/calvin.md). Dave said he's been good, hanging out with friends at parks — he's arranged regular walks with friends and shared a photo of the spot: a city skyline with a river and boats (details in ## Parks). Calvin shared photos of his Japanese mansion (backyard with a boat docked in a canal at sunset; the mansion front), and Dave marveled that the peace by the river is really nice and that the views from the mansion "must be amazing" (details in /memories/calvin.md > ## New home (2023-03-23)) [S10T1][S10T2][S10T3][S10T5][S10T6][S10T7][S10T8].
- The 2023-07-07 conversation continued: Calvin is looking forward to trying the Japanese food and checking out the culture; Dave has never been to Japan but is "so keen to go one day" and is "hooked on" Japanese music (details in ## Japan). Dave is excited about Calvin's collaborations with Japanese artists — "a great chance", "can't wait for the tunes!", "can't wait to see/hear the end product" — and Calvin promised to share clips and said he can't wait to show him. The conversation closed with Calvin thanking Dave for all the help ("Appreciate all the help"), saying "Great catching up, gotta get back to work now. Take care!" [S10T9][S10T10][S10T11][S10T12][S10T13][S10T14][S10T15][S10T16]. Dave signed off last: "Hey Cal, take care and don't overwork yourself! Talk to you soon. Stay safe!" [S10T17].
- On 2023-08-03, caught up with Calvin ("long time no see!"): Calvin told him his recent Ferrari service was so stressful (he's attached to the car) and asked what kind of hobbies give Dave a feeling of being restored; Dave said fixing cars is like therapy for him — growing up working on cars with his dad, refurbishing gives fulfillment — and shared his fond childhood memory of spending a summer with his dad restoring an old car (details in ## Hobbies and sense of purpose) [S12T1][S12T2][S12T4].

- On 2023-10-29, told Dave that since they last talked he went to a networking event to meet more artists — "so cool!" — and that the people he met will help him build up his fan base — "super excited about what it could lead to." (an active step in his plan to expand his brand and grow his fanbase — see the 2023-08-03 entry above; Dave's side in the Relationships section of /memories/dave.md) [S27T1].
- On 2023-10-29, when Dave asked for music updates ("How's everything with the music? Any updates?"): Calvin said he'd had some great collaborations recently ("I've had some great collaborations recently") and his album is almost finished ("my album is almost finished") — a follow-up to the album that dropped 2023-09-11 (see above) — and promised he'll send Dave some previews soon ("I'll send you some previews soon"; Dave: "Cool, Calvin! Can't wait to hear it.") [S27T10][S27T11][S27T12].
- On 2023-11-02, told Dave that last week (~2023-10-26) he threw a small party at his Japanese mansion (see ## New home (2023-03-23)) for his new album — "It was amazing, so much love from my fam and friends!" (the 2023-10-29 update above had his album at "almost finished") — and shared photos of the party: a group of people sitting in a room with a projector screen ("Take a look at the photo of the party in the mansion, it was so energizing!"), a group of people dancing at the party, and a group of people standing on top of a stage [S28T1][S28T3][S28T5].
